issues.on_page: Operating expenses of an irrigation district (Personnel costs ... Depreciation)
issues.issue: All 9 expense lines are filed as 'utilities' and entity_type is 'public power / utility'. The rules list water and drainage districts under 'natural resources/conservation'. An irrigation district selling water tolls can fairly be treated as a utility, but a person should decide.
Noncurrent compensated absences; rules limit 'accrued liabilities' to amounts due soon. 'other liabilities' may fit better.
